title: THE ART OF LIFE Louise Carey 1000 Piece Panoramic Puzzle NEW SEALED
descriptionText: The "Art of Life" puzzle by Andrews & Blaine is a 1000 piece panoramic puzzle featuring the artwork of Louise Carey. With a colorful and intricate design, this puzzle is perfect for adults and older teens who enjoy a challenging and engaging activity. The high-quality cardboard material ensures durability and the puzzle is sealed to maintain its freshness. Ideal for art enthusiasts and puzzle lovers alike, this beautifully themed puzzle is a great way to spend time and relax.
